hlaunit.hla13.saverestore

Class FederationSaveTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • hlaunit.hla13.common.Abstract13Test
      • hlaunit.hla13.saverestore.FederationSaveTest

  • public class FederationSaveTest
extends Abstract13Test
    These tests validate that the process of calls required to carry out a federation save works correctly (and that when fed improper input, that they fail correctly). Please note that these tests do NOT validate that the appropriate state was saved/restored properly. For example, the tests to ensure that the proper time-status for federates is saved/restored are located in the time management tests.
